description: PostgreSQL 16 query plans for the leased reconciliation queue (#416, migration 0026). Captured with EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) after ANALYZE on 200,000 rows spread over the 2026-10 and 2026-11 partitions (1% live, 1% dead_letter, the rest recorded). Partitions with no rows show a Seq Scan over zero rows; every populated partition uses the index named here.

fixtures.name: reconciliation_claim_due_jobs
fixtures.query: SELECT id, created_at FROM public.reconciliation_queue WHERE status IN ('not_submitted', 'submitted_not_confirmed', 'confirmed_not_recorded') AND next_attempt_at <= NOW() AND (lease_token IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < NOW()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at LIMIT 15 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

plan.filter_predicate: status = ANY ('{not_submitted,submitted_not_confirmed,confirmed_not_recorded}'::text[]) AND (lease_token IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < now())
plan.note: Partial index: terminal rows are never scanned, so claim cost follows the backlog, not the history.

fixtures.name: reconciliation_poison_lease_sweep
fixtures.query: SELECT id, created_at FROM public.reconciliation_queue WHERE lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at < NOW() AND lease_recoveries >= max_lease_recoveries AND status IN ('not_submitted', 'submitted_not_confirmed', 'confirmed_not_recorded') FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

fixtures.name: reconciliation_enqueue_dedupe_lookup
fixtures.query: SELECT * FROM public.reconciliation_queue q WHERE q.dedupe_key = 'intent:123' ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

fixtures.name: reconciliation_dead_letter_listing
fixtures.query: SELECT id FROM public.reconciliation_queue WHERE status = 'dead_letter' ORDER BY dead_lettered_at DESC LIMIT 50

concurrency.description: Measured against PostgreSQL 16 with concurrent psql sessions calling claim_reconciliation_jobs().
